desc:
🚇 LINE UP! Metro Tycoon
Connect stations, build your own railway lines, and expand your city!

Build new stations, connect your lines, and transport more passengers to grow your income. Use your earnings to upgrade stations and build a variety of landmarks to develop your city even further.

🚆 Start in the city of your choice and expand your railway network to cities around the world, including Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, and the United States.

🚉 Discover new routes,
🏙️ Develop your cities,
💰 Grow your profits, and
🌏 Connect the world by rail!

Build your very own railway empire.
